pages.title: The Crystal Barrens
pages.text: Not all of the Hollow is ash. In some reaches the pale stone has grown $(l)crystal$(): spires of amethyst, clusters on every ledge, and geodes hanging alone in the dark.$(br2)The air hums there. Glimmerstone runs through the islands as it does at home, but Voidstone is scarce.$(br2)The Barrens and the ashen Hollow lie in great alternating reaches, each a few hundred blocks across.
